text:
```yaml
name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - renovate/**
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull request number'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  update-lock:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == 'renovate[bot]' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml@main
    with:
      prNumber: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.prNumber || '' }}
    secrets: inherit
```
